name: What is a tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms an existing bathtub area into a dedicated shower space. This typically involves removing the bathtub, modifying plumbing, installing a new shower pan, wall surrounds, and shower fixtures. It's a popular bathroom remodel for homeowners seeking increased accessibility, a more modern aesthetic, or simply preferring showers over baths. The process can vary in complexity depending on the existing bathroom layout and desired new features.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tub-to-shower conversion transforms an existing bathtub into a dedicated shower space, involving plumbing, pan, and fixture changes.
